## Mobile web chat

This release adds a small mobile-friendly web UI that controls an existing meshmsg daemon through the same bounded local IPC protocol as the CLI.

### Highlights

- Broadcast text messages from a browser without creating another mesh identity.
- Keep active web views synchronized with messages sent through the CLI, chat, or other browser tabs.
- See incoming and locally queued messages with explicit “queued, not delivered” semantics.
- View safe, read-only attachment metadata for incoming and locally shared file and directory offers.
- Use an embedded responsive dark-console UI with no frontend build or runtime asset directory.
- Access it locally over loopback, or privately through Tailscale Serve.

Start the daemon and local web UI:

```sh
meshmsg daemon
meshmsg web
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:8787/`.

For phone access, configure an exact HTTPS origin and proxy it through **Tailscale Serve, never Funnel**:

```sh
meshmsg web --origin https://my-host.my-tailnet.ts.net
tailscale serve --bg --https=443 http://127.0.0.1:8787
```

There is no application login: tailnet access rules are the remote-access boundary. The HTTP bridge exposes only text send/status and a filtered live event stream. It does not expose daemon shutdown, attachment upload/download, signed offer tokens, blob tickets, or filesystem paths.

See [Mobile web UI](https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/blob/v0.1.10/docs/web.md) for setup, behavior, limits, and validation guidance.

### Install

```sh
curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -fsSL \
  https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/main/install.sh | bash
```

Or install this exact release from source:

```sh
cargo install --git https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg.git \
  --tag v0.1.10 --locked --force
```

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Eldar-Ahmadov/meshmsg/compare/v0.1.9...v0.1.10
